mapper.select: SELECT dqlr.dates, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.version, dqlr.source_type, dul.config_group_type, dul.name config_group_name, COUNT(distinct dqlr.user_id) active_user_num, SUM(dqlr.event_ltv) active_event_ltv, SUM(dqlr.user_ltv) active_user_ltv, COUNT(distinct dui.user_id) new_user_num, SUM(dqlr.event_ltv) new_user_event_ltv, SUM(dqlr.user_ltv) new_user_ltv FROM dwd_qp_ltv_record dqlr LEFT JOIN dim_user_info dui on (dui.user_id = dqlr.user_id and dui.dates = dqlr.dates) INNER JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.user_id = dqlr.user_id) where dqlr.dates = #{dates} GROUP BY dqlr.dates, dqlr.pkg, dqlr.version, dqlr.source_type, dul.config_group_type, dul.name
